Title: Philosophy and the Modern Mind

Author: Sample Author

Release date: January 1, 2010

This is a sample OCR column with hard-wrapped lines typ-
ical of scanned books where the right margin breaks mid-
word and sentences continue on the next physical line.

Philosophy begins in wonder, as Aristotle said long ago
in the Metaphysics. The modern reader may find these line
breaks distracting unless the parser joins them correctly.

Another paragraph begins here after a blank line. Short lines
should still merge when they clearly belong to one thought
and no structural heading interrupts the flow.
